== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)]] (Virtual Block 7.1), showing the '''PC-E2''' game text. No published image shows this text; the other versions of the card are [[Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Virtual Block 7)]] (original); [[Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]] (PC-E1); [[Restore Freedom To The Galaxy (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive), unchanged in every capture to 11 January 2013. The card list writes icons out; icons are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E2 text:''' “Deploy on Yavin 4. Once per turn, may deploy a battleground system or an interior Yavin 4 site. Whenever you Force drain at another battleground system, may draw destiny. Add 1 for each Yavin 4 site on table (2 if you occupy). If total destiny > 6, stack top card from either player's Reserve Deck there (limit one per system) to 'liberate' the system. At 'liberated' systems: Force drains are +1, and at same and related locations your total power is +3 and you draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. If opponent Force drains at a 'liberated' system, place stacked card in owner's Used Pile.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1007_L5867</code> (printed frame, the Players Committee card image (full-art scan), title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 7 set mark) with the PC-E2 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. CardMaker's Critical Mission template does not draw the [Setup] icon on the banner.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
